programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: City Buzz or Garden Bliss in Amsterdam
programs.desc: Inspired by the European lifestyle, a newlywed couple relocates from Chicago to Amsterdam; she's transferring her job and wants a quiet neighborhood and a garden; he isn't working and craves the excitement of the city center's hustle and bustle.

programs.title: Crashers
programs.desc: Jon Knight and his team stun Holly and Ed, who run a blended household of seven, three businesses, and a working farm, with a 72-hour primary suite overhaul, turning their long-neglected space into the peaceful retreat they've never given themselves.

programs.title: Castle Impossible
programs.desc: Daphne and Ian need to stand out from the crowd to secure wedding bookings, so they turn their restrooms into luxury powder rooms. The discovery of a hidden bridge in the forest inspires them to add Renaissance-style murals to the powder room walls.

programs.title: Castle Impossible
programs.sub_title: Granny and the Gutted Gatehouse: Part Two
programs.desc: Granny expresses shock at the unfinished state of the gatehouse interior. Daphne and Ian install a castle view mezzanine, find a statement chandelier at Tony's in Normandy, and add special touches for Charlie the cat.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Kicking things off at a house with a 727 airplane inside; exploring a pink time capsule-esque penthouse.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer is back on the hunt to find wild homes!; his journey takes him to resurrected ruins of a desert ghost town, a concrete castle in the mountains, and a home that's mostly black and white.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer searches for wild homes and goes chugga-chuggin' down to a cozy train caboose hideaway; next, he dreams in color at a pastel-painted ranch and stops by a desert dream oasis; only one home can reign supreme!

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer hunts for wildness in Florida and starts with a maritime-themed property with its own shark!; next, he heads to an estate honoring military flight and sees a storybook-shaped home.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Exploring a secret underground residence 26 feet below the surface that features a full house, a front and backyard, and even a pool; time stands still here and proves that wild doesn't always have to be out in the open.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer continues his hunt for the wildest homes as he explores an off-grid abode built into a cave in the Ozarks; he visits an Alexander the Great inspired villa in the suburbs and tours an artistic sanctuary nestled among the desert rocks.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer hits the road to see which home is worth the while; he begins his search at a Bavarian themed lodge, explores a two-tower maze house filled with art and sculptures, then tours a home converted from a 19th-century church.

programs.title: Ugliest House in America
programs.desc: Retta begins her quest to find ugly as three homes in the Great Plains region vie for a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it's between a house with off-the-wall decor, a home that looks like a dog, and a house with light switches galore.
